_comment: THE POPULATION THE cmdguard PARITY HARNESS IS KEYED ON.
cmdguard-corpus.json is a SAMPLE of commands; these are the TABLES the two ported
implementations decide from. Measured 2026-08-19: 25 of the 39 entries below had no
corpus case, so a one-sided edit to any of them passed BOTH suites in silence — adding
"awk" to the Go pipeFilters and nothing else left Go and TypeScript green.
extension/src/agent/cmdguard-tables.test.ts each assert their own tables equal this file,
so widening one side fails that side, and widening this file fails both.
An entry here is not a permission: it is a record of what the two guards must AGREE on.
Changing a guard means changing this file too, deliberately, in the same commit.
